headline.zh: 金融机构智能代理平台

scenario.zh: 探索 Agent AI 如何协助金融机构处理复杂分析任务，从文档提取洞察到生成结构化报告
scenario.en: Explore how Agent AI assists financial institutions with complex analysis, from extracting insights to generating structured reports

instruction.zh: Agent 从文档提取信息并生成结构化输出
instruction.en: Agent extracts information and generates structured output

output.zh: 提取关键条款和合规要点
output.en: Extract key terms and compliance points

input.zh: 第12条规定：交易对手方信用风险敞口需每日重新计算，使用标准化方法评估抵押品价值，并在T+1日内向监管机构报送
input.en: Section 12: Counterparty credit exposure must be recalculated daily using standardized collateral valuation and reported to regulators within T+1

output.zh: 关键义务：每日重估｜方法：标准化估值｜时限：T+1报送｜适用：所有交易对手
output.en: Key obligation: Daily revaluation | Method: Standardized valuation | Deadline: T+1 reporting | Scope: All counterparties

output.zh: 将非结构化文本转为可比数据点
output.en: Convert unstructured text to comparable data

input.zh: Q4营收同比增长，净息差环比收窄15个基点，不良贷款率维持在行业中位水平
input.en: Q4 revenue grew year-over-year, net interest margin narrowed quarter-over-quarter by 15bps, NPL ratio remains at industry median

output.zh: 营收趋势：同比上升｜净息差：环比收窄15bps｜资产质量：行业中位｜整体：稳健增长
output.en: Revenue: YoY increase | NIM: QoQ -15bps | Asset quality: Industry median | Overall: Stable growth

instruction.zh: Agent 按指定结构组织分析结果
instruction.en: Agent organizes findings in specified structure

output.zh: 生成可操作的风险项列表

input.zh: 基于三份信贷协议和最新监管通知
input.en: Based on three credit agreements and recent regulatory notice

output.zh: 流动性：需额外抵押品｜合规：报送时限缩短｜交易对手：集中度偏高｜操作：系统升级待完成
output.en: Liquidity: Additional collateral needed | Compliance: Reporting deadline shortened | Counterparty: Concentration elevated | Operational: System upgrade pending

detail.zh: 抵押品缺口需在下周补足
detail.en: Collateral gap to be filled next week

detail.zh: 新报送要求三个工作日内生效
detail.en: New reporting requirement effective in 3 days

detail.zh: 单一交易对手敞口超过内部限额
detail.en: Single counterparty exposure above internal limit

output.zh: 综合多份文件为简明建议

input.zh: 市场报告3份、内部头寸快照、监管问询函
input.en: 3 market reports, internal position snapshot, regulator inquiry

output.zh: 建议：削减高波动资产敞口｜依据：VaR已接近限额且监管关注流动性｜时间表：本月内完成｜需协调：交易台和风控部门
output.en: Recommendation: Reduce high-volatility exposure | Rationale: VaR near limit and regulator focused on liquidity | Timeline: Complete this month | Coordination: Trading desk and risk

takeaway.zh: 示例展示了 Agent 如何将金融文档转为结构化分析，实际产品能力需在 Rogo 平台验证，包括多文档协同和实时数据整合
takeaway.en: Examples show how Agent converts financial documents into structured analysis; actual capabilities including multi-document coordination and real-time data integration must be verified on Rogo platform
